# Installing

The project is managed with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

```
uv sync
uv run pytest
```

`uv sync` creates `.venv/` next to the lock file and installs the pinned
versions; `uv run` executes a command inside it without activating anything.

args.content:
# Installing

The project is managed with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

```
uv sync --all-groups
uv run pytest
```

`uv sync --all-groups` creates `.venv/` next to the lock file and installs the
pinned versions of the runtime *and* the development dependencies; `uv run`
executes a command inside it without activating anything.
